capabilities: Sync notes and attachments with Yandex Disk over WebDAV in two-way or mirror modes
Preview changes before confirming and compare file versions
Resolve conflicts by editing, choosing a version, or skipping files
Detect moves and renames when paths have matching content
Restore previous versions from the sync report as local files
disambiguation: Not a general WebDAV client; it targets Yandex Disk specifically and only syncs when you start it.
extras: Warns that the app password is stored locally as plain text, that recovery copies and logs stay on-device, and advises keeping a separate backup of the vault. Notes that the first sync is slower because it reads cloud files, with cached comparisons afterwards. Available in English and Russian. Listed as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Sync is a paid service and doesn't cover Yandex Disk, so users need a way to sync their vault through that cloud storage.

relations.evidence: Manually sync Obsidian notes and attachments with Yandex Disk on desktop and mobile.

requires.name: Yandex account with a Files WebDAV app password

summary: Manual two-way sync plugin that exchanges notes and attachments with Yandex Disk over WebDAV, with preview, conflict resolution and version restore.
